integrity: The exact finite-field and dimension-uniform result is proved by a primitive-vector factorization; small enumerations independently check finite instances but do not certify an infinite theorem. Mathematical originality has not undergone independent review.
limitations: Only rank-one matrices over a one-variable polynomial ring; q, m, n fixed in the limiting law. The unweighted two-by-two case was previously published. No higher-rank classification or uniform-parameter limit is asserted. Possible equivalent general Segre height-zeta statements remain a bibliographic risk.
title: The content-height zeta function of rank-one polynomial matrices
